item.title: The Michael Knowles Show: Michael REACTS To Hilarious GTA 6 TikToks
item.description: 2 funny bits: “The last time I played video games, they came they came on something called a compact disc. I don't know if you were familiar with those. >> CDs. >> No one has CDs >> No, sweetheart. CD stands for certificate of deposit.”

item.title: The Andrew Klavan Show: Ep. 1295 - 9/11 And the Search for Accountability
item.description: 5 funny bits: “The first day, I was so jet-lagged from a trip to England that I forgot to put my shoes on and arrived wearing bedroom slippers. I stumbled through a short opening podcast that ended with that Bible quote, \"This is the day that the Lord has made.\" It was like nothing else I'd ever done. So when I was finished, I asked Jeremy, \"How'd it go?\" He said, \"Great, but you say uh too much.\" I said, \"Well, what can I do about that?\" He said, \"You cannot say it.\”

item.title: The Ben Shapiro Show: Ben Reacts to the $2,000 iPhone
item.description: 1 funny bit: “So for nearly a century, according to the Wall Street Journal, mathematicians have tried to determine whether smooth solutions to the equations describing threedimensional fluid motion always remain smooth or if they ever break down. So to put it less mathematically, on paper, can water blow up?”

item.title: The Matt Walsh Show: Ep. 1835 - Pilots Saw This Disaster Coming. No One Listened.
item.description: 2 funny bits: “It's called the September reset because apparently doing something sensible now requires branding. But one useful rule is to handle important things while you're thinking about them. Uh write it down, put it on a calendar, or take care of it immediately. Otherwise, you're assigning the task to your future self, a man with the same bad habits and even less time.”
